purpose: zero-trade reference arm uses one incremental last-point family and one anchored family indicator per chart

applyTo.rule: apply the same two indicator definitions to each CONF-05 chart so the trade-bearing and zero-trade arms differ only by trades

selectedIndicators.why: EMA is in the incremental-safe family; last/forming point can update from carried recursive state without whole-series recompute.
VWAP is an anchored family; correctness depends on the configured anchorPeriod and carried accumulators if starting inside an anchor.

guardrails: rsi with divergenceEnabled is not incremental-safe
centered or shifted presentations may leave the displayed last point null/unchanged until context exists

requirements.vwap: configured anchorPeriod plus prior cumPV/cumP2V/cumVol when starting inside an anchor
requirements.obv: prior OBV baseline scalar plus previous close
requirements.psar: trend direction, extreme point, acceleration factor, SAR value and clamp bars
requirements.seasonality: keyed day-of-year sample store; no backward bar window fixes it

doNotUseForCONF05.reason: valuable negative-result family but non-causal; may require updating every visible bar sharing a day-of-year key and can render null with insufficient samples, so it is not the clean anchored representative for tonight's paired soak.
